teaser.en: Too bitter and sour to eat fresh, the Seville orange earns its place in the kitchen and in home medicine.
teaser.sw: Ni mchungu na mchachu mno kuliwa bichi, lakini mdanzi umejipatia nafasi jikoni na katika dawa za nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Matundage ni ga utsungu na ngbwadu sana hata tagariwa dza garivyo, ela *mdandzi* una nafasiye dzikoni na kpwenye dawa za kaya.

summary.en: *Mdandzi* is the sour or Seville orange, a citrus tree with bitter-sour fruit grown around homesteads. Its juice is used in cooking and in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdandzi* ni mdanzi, mti wa jamii ya michungwa wenye matunda machungu na machachu unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Maji ya matunda yake hutumika katika upishi na katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdandzi* ni *sour orange* au *Seville orange*, muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye matunda ga utsungu na ngbwadu, unaophandwa phephi na midzi. Madzi ga matundage nkuhumirwa kujitira na kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mdandzi* is an evergreen citrus tree with glossy leaves on winged leaf stalks, often thorny, with very fragrant white flowers.

The fruit looks like an orange, with a rough, thick skin, but its pulp is sour and bitter rather than sweet.
about.sw:
*Mdandzi* ni mti wa familia ya michungwa wa kijani kibichi daima, wenye majani yanayong'aa juu ya vikonyo vyenye mabawa, mara nyingi wenye miiba, na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri sana.

Tunda linafanana na chungwa, lenye ganda gumu na nene, lakini nyama yake ni chachu na chungu badala ya kuwa tamu.
about.dg:
*Mdandzi* ni muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala na ganamera dzulu ya milita yenye mapha; mara nyinji muhi una miya, na maruwage mereru gana arufu nono sana.

Tunda rinaonekana dza chungbwa, na gada ziho ririrokaraza, ela nyamaye ni ya ngbwadu na utsungu, si ya mtswano.

where.en: *Mdandzi* is a homestead tree, grown near houses where its fruit is on hand.
where.sw: *Mdandzi* ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na nyumba ili matunda yake yapatikane kwa urahisi.
where.dg: *Mdandzi* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na nyumba phatu matundage ganaphokala phephi.

uses.en: The juice is used in cooking, to add a sharp, sour flavour to food. It is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Maji ya tunda hutumika katika upishi, kuongeza ladha kali ya uchachu kwenye chakula. Pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg: Madzi ga tunda nkuhumirwa kujitira, kuika ladha kali ya ngbwadu chakuryani. Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: Digo: *mdandzi*. Swahili: *mdanzi*. English: sour orange or Seville orange. Scientists call it *Citrus aurantium*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdandzi*. Kiswahili: *mdanzi*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sour orange* au *Seville orange*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus aurantium*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdandzi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mdanzi*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *sour orange* au *Seville orange*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Citrus aurantium*.
